products.title: Odor Neutralizer
products.body_html:
Targets odor-causing bacteria to refresh footwear from within.

This fast-acting spray neutralizes odor-causing bacteria and moisture to restore freshness to your footwear. It can be used on any type of footwear—from boots to trainers.

Step one
Remove insole. Shake bottle well before use. Hold the bottle away from the insole and spray. Cover the entirety of the sole.

Step two
Spray inside the boot to refresh internally.

Step three
Let the insole and shoes air dry completely before replacing and wearing. Repeat if shoes are heavily worn.

Keep out of reach of children.

products.body_html:
A fast-acting spray that protects and restores all rubber footwear.

Conditions and protects rubber footwear (boots and rain shoes) to restore suppleness, prevent dryness and cracks, and maintain color and comfort. Use regularly to help it last.

Step one
Ensure the shoe is clean. Wipe off any dirt or water.

Step two
Shake the bottle and spray onto the shoe from 15cm away.

Step three
Rub evenly over the rubber with a clean, dry cloth until all is absorbed.

Step four
Remove excess with a dry cloth.
